claims.label: thm:main
claims.reviewed_scope: Exact strict radii, full marked-order law, global detector bounds, arbitrary independent probability seed; R in [1,2], n positive.

exports.name: QuantyraNullCone.physical_volume_joint_rate
exports.accepted_type:
QuantyraNullCone.physical_volume_joint_rate.{u_1} {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hR2 : R ≤ 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
  (∀ (rho pi : QuantyraNullCone.DiamondPoint → ℝ),
      QuantyraNullCone.VolumeRateModel R rho pi →
        (QuantyraNullCone.retainedMarkedOrderLaw rho pi n QuantyraNullCone.volumeRateAnchors).real
            {code |
              2 * QuantyraNullCone.physicalVolumeRate n R <
                |QuantyraNullCone.markedOrderFraction 0 1 code - QuantyraNullCone.physicalMarkedVolume rho|} ≤
          1 / 20) ∧
    ∀ (Ω : Type u_1) [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (xi : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure xi]
      (T : QuantyraNullCone.UnlabeledMarkedOrderCode n 2 × Ω → ℝ),
      Measurable T →
        ∃ rho pi,
          QuantyraNullCone.VolumeRateModel R rho pi ∧
            1 / 4 ≤
              ((QuantyraNullCone.retainedMarkedOrderLaw rho pi n QuantyraNullCone.volumeRateAnchors).prod xi).real
                {z | QuantyraNullCone.physicalVolumeRate n R / 256 < |T z - QuantyraNullCone.physicalMarkedVolume rho|}

exports.accepted_type:
QuantyraNullCone.physical_volume_joint_rate_lower.{u_1} {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hR2 : R ≤ 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
  {Ω : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (xi : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure xi]

  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu] {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (anchors : Fin m → QuantyraNullCone.DiamondPoint)
  (p q : Fin m) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :

exports.name: QuantyraNullCone.poisson_retained_laplace_functional
exports.accepted_type:
QuantyraNullCone.poisson_retained_laplace_functional.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (kappa : NNReal) {pi : Ω → ℝ}
  (hpi : Measurable pi) (hInt : MeasureTheory.Integrable pi mu) (hbounds : ∀ (x : Ω), pi x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1)
  (hZ : 0 < ∫ (x : Ω), pi x ∂mu) (fallback : Ω) {h : Ω → ℝ} (hh : Measurable h) (hnonneg : ∀ (x : Ω), 0 ≤ h x) :
  ∫ (z : ℕ × (ℕ → Ω × ℝ)),
      Real.exp
        (-∑ i,
            h
              (QuantyraNullCone.mixedRetainedView pi fallback (QuantyraNullCone.mixedRetainedCount pi z) z
                i)) ∂QuantyraNullCone.randomGeneratedLaw mu (ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure kappa) =
    Real.exp (↑kappa * ∫ (x : Ω), pi x * (Real.exp (-h x) - 1) ∂mu)

claims.label: thm:report
claims.reviewed_scope: Real endpoint coverage theorem; executable tables use rational delta/endpoints. Known-range intersection is an elementary event inclusion. Process specializations are accepted for rational tables; the real-table statement follows by the same proved tuple laws.

exports.accepted_type:
QuantyraNullCone.binomial_tail_interval_coverage {n : ℕ} {p delta : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hd : 0 ≤ delta)
  (L U : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hL : ∀ (k : Fin (n + 1)), L k ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hU : ∀ (k : Fin (n + 1)), U k ∈ Set.Icc 0 1)
  (hcL : ∀ (k : Fin (n + 1)), L k = 0 ∨ QuantyraNullCone.binomialUpperTail n k (L k) ≤ delta / 2)
